opencode-ahp `1.0.2` — AHP 1.0.0 host for opencode v2, published to npm.

**Install** ([README — Install](https://github.com/mattzink/opencode-ahp/blob/main/README.md#install)):

```bash
opencode plugin add opencode-ahp
```

or pin this build: `opencode plugin add opencode-ahp@1.0.2`

## Commits
- [1162e56](https://github.com/mattzink/opencode-ahp/commit/1162e56b69ff48834e2d62b78451d93b25aba266) Cap session title updates at 256 characters (Matt Zinkevicius)
- [4370c66](https://github.com/mattzink/opencode-ahp/commit/4370c66dc423d6be431be34e9c5bbc5de011f7a0) Show OpenCode session titles in VS Code (#4) (mocki-toki)
- [b805249](https://github.com/mattzink/opencode-ahp/commit/b8052491bef3309ec374747392a3c7997b6b72e0) Report context usage from the latest model call (#3) (mocki-toki)
- [afe2f65](https://github.com/mattzink/opencode-ahp/commit/afe2f65ddf42b31941634e43409fb4509c70b371) Preserve the selected VS Code workspace directory (#2) (mocki-toki)
